breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to take the maximum in-plane shear as the average transverse shear stress alone, ignoring the normal stress component. The generated specification correctly removed this flawed instruction and instead included the correct formula, `τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)^2 + τ_avg^2)`, which properly accounts for both normal and shear stresses, aligning perfectly with the ground truth.
